title: fix(spec): os migrate meta guidance for fourteen more migration-entry families states each lesson in words, not tracker numbers (stage 7)
body:
Part of #20233
Stage 7: the actor-, hot-, external-, query-, delete-, etl-, storage-, apimethod-, dashboard-, notification-, record-, runtime-, rls- and scim- families.

Clause-②: no

Text only. In these families' ADR-0087 semantic entries, the `reason` / `replacement` / `acceptanceCriteria` prose that `os migrate meta` prints now states in words what each cited ruling, measurement or fix decided, instead of a tracker number (form D, ruling C+D `5749154545`). ADR ids stay. No entry `id`, `from` / `to`, conversion or matcher changes.

- The stage-6 carry-over: `18.rest-api-endpoint-handler-status-retired` names the API skill.
- `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` adds the fourteen families to `COVERED_PREFIXES`; its `REWRITTEN` floor rises to 174.
- `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` and `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` are regenerated.
- `patch` changeset.

The census, the text-only proof, the ablation and the test runs are in the dev report on #20233 (`5883241063`).
